findings.title: Following proc-exe metadata access precedes target validation
findings.evidence: process_points preserves os.readlink('/proc/self/exe'), then calls following os.stat('/proc/self/exe') before checking cwd or equality of the observed executable target to BINDING['interpreter']['final']. It is called at beginning, after keys and closing.
findings.consequence: The source's explicit unexpected-symlink-target-before-further-access promise is not implemented at this proc endpoint. Prior map allowlisting rejects some unexpected targets but is not a per-link equality guard or an authorization to follow any target before its role is checked. This is a source-order defect, not evidence that an out-of-scope read occurred; the frozen source is disabled.
findings.required_resolution: In a separately commissioned new-only source, preserve readlink evidence and reject unapproved target/cwd observations before following executable metadata. Retain later complete-key comparisons and point-check/race limits. Do not change the frozen source, broaden the frontier or claim a sandbox.

findings.title: Generic RuntimeError arguments are incorrectly treated as owned internal codes
findings.location: observe.py:109-113 and uses in prehelper/helper-import/file/outer handlers
findings.evidence: failure(exc) exports exc.args[0] whenever type(exc) is RuntimeError. That equality proves the class, not that need() or an observer-owned finite failure site created the exception. A RuntimeError supplied by a helper or supported runtime operation follows the same branch.
findings.consequence: The stated no-arbitrary-exception-text rule is not supported. For an externally originated RuntimeError carrying a message, its first argument becomes emitted 'code'; no actual private value or live failure was observed. Empty args also are not safely indexed, but no independent liveness/guaranteed-receipt claim is added to this finding.
findings.required_resolution: A new-only source must distinguish observer-owned bounded codes from generic runtime exceptions, emit only reviewed finite internal codes/appropriate non-sensitive class-errno labels, and not forward arbitrary args based only on RuntimeError type. Preserve failure state and complete captured evidence without adding imports/discovery or a receipt guarantee.

scope_limits: Intentional BINDING=None and unconditional capture exit are not defects and remain unchanged.
Full expected launch and phase-specific module rows are not supplied by the accepted design or archive-name authority; no exact binding is accepted.
Seven design obligations are assessed as source mechanisms and future binding/reception duties, not seven completed runtime tests.
